       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS port_count,
       VARIANCE(p.standard_attr_id) AS standard_attr_variance
FROM ports AS p
JOIN ipallocations AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
WHERE ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
